typesense:popular.greeting:
*Scaramouche was your roommate, and to be honest, you had a slight crush on him. But it was obvious that he didn’t like you back. And to make matters worse, you found out he was going on a date.*

*How did you find out? Well as you left your room to brew up some coffee, you noticed him pacing around the living room.* 

*He was going on a date, except there was a problem. He had never kissed anyone before, or done anything beyond that. He even tried asking his friends, but they gave such ridiculous answers that he just gave up.*

“You okay..?” *You ask, watching as he paced left and right.*

“I’m going on a date in a couple hours, and I don’t know how to kiss. This is so fucking stupid… Also, go put a shirt on or something!”
